subject: reading-17-read-exact-b-spline-geometry
observed: Python 3.13 with pywin32, late-bound. A saved part, one solid loft (4 faces: 2 planar ends, 2 lofted skin faces), opened read-only; the two edges of one planar end and the skin face beside each were read. ISurface.Parameterization2 then GetBSurfParams3(False, False, VP0, 0.01, out sense) returned IBSurfParamData in about 0.012 s a face: bicubic, non-rational (dimension 3), non-periodic; UKnots 8 and VKnots 102 values (4 x 98 poles) with ControlPointColumnCount 4 and ControlPointRowCount 98, and UKnots 183, VKnots 102 (179 x 98 poles) with ControlPointColumnCount 179 and ControlPointRowCount 98. GetControlPoints(Row 1..n_u, Column 1..n_v) gave exactly one 3-number point on each of 392 and 17,542 calls. ICurve.GetBCurveParams5(False, False, False, IsClosed) returned ISplineParamData: a degree-1 curve of 2 poles and 4 knots, and a cubic of 505 poles and 509 knots; GetControlPoints and GetKnotPoints returned True. IEdge.GetCurveParams3: range 0 to 1, Sense True, CurveType 3005, StartPoint equal to Evaluate2 at UMinValue. Rebuilt in Open CASCADE, every curve and surface matched SolidWorks' own ICurve.Evaluate2 and ISurface.Evaluate to 2.4e-13 mm or better, only with Row as u (Column as u was 436 mm and 622 mm off); against SolidWorks' own STEP of the part, the same degrees, pole counts, knots (difference 0.0), poles (0.0 mm), non-rational, 0.0 mm at matched parameters. Save flag clear before and after. The 179 x 98 face took 28 s, nearly all in GetControlPoints (about 1.6 ms a call). Earlier runs of earlier code: VP0 Nothing with Tolerance 1e-10, on a copy already open with unsaved changes and with the machine reported short of memory, was followed by SolidWorks ending inside GetBSurfParams3 after 19.2 s (0x800706BE); GetControlPoints(0, 0) returned an empty array; Row bounded by ControlPointRowCount gave 16 of 392 and 9,604 of 17,542 points, the rest empty arrays with no error.
